reason: ₹22,000 is more than a month of what my whole household earns, and my wife washes by hand like we always have. The ₹2,000 a month EMI would come out of food and fees in the months the crop money has not come in.
objection: I have never heard of this brand, and a battery is the costly part that dies. If it fails after three years in a village, I am left with an expensive box, and the machine still needs water that my pump only gives when the power is on.
would_change_my_mind: If it cost under ₹12,000 and a neighbour in my village had used one for a year without trouble.
